spans.title: The Voice Over Her Shoulder
spans.blurb: Alone in her grand hotel suite, a princess hears something move, checks every room, finds nothing, and settles into her bath. Then a voice speaks at her ear.
spans.brokenNote: The passage stops mid-sentence just as the intruder's voice begins, so the scene has no ending.

spans.title: Pennies for the Monkey
spans.blurb: On a seaside honeymoon a bride kisses the dog, laughs at the monkey, and delights in everything except her new husband, who wants to know why.

spans.title: The Parable of the Onion
spans.blurb: A woman retells a folk tale her cook taught her: a wicked soul in a lake of fire, an angel, and one small onion held out in hope.

spans.title: The Night Climb
spans.blurb: Three men slip a skiff into a moonlit Kent cove in 1656. Their fierce leader knows a hidden way up the sheer cliff, and takes it.

spans.title: The Buried Hat
spans.blurb: A boy hauling iron ore forgets, for one moment, that thirsty oxen and a high bridge make a dangerous pair. His hat pays the price.

spans.title: Making Him Talk
spans.blurb: Determined to crack a silent companion, a lively girl peppers him with questions while he weaves a birch basket. His answers are shorter than her patience.

spans.title: Into the Burning Wood
spans.blurb: Told the forest fire is too far to visit, a wilful girl marches straight toward it. The flames are grander and hungrier than she bargained for.

books.pairNote: Two separate outings with the same pair, one playful and one perilous; neither steals the other's payoff.

spans.title: The Nantucket Pudding
spans.blurb: A guest who has already dined is pressed to try his hostess's prized pudding. Politeness demands one plate; hospitality has other plans.

spans.title: Followed Through the Ruins
spans.blurb: A foreign traveler misses his turn at midnight in Moscow and strays into a quarter where a giant figure begins to follow. He speaks no Russian, and he is unarmed.

spans.title: Why Should I Be Fought For
spans.blurb: A husband appears at the terrace window while his wife stands with her lover. As a storm gathers outside, three people try to decide what happens next.
spans.spoilerNote: Reveals that the wife's affair with the narrator exists and is discovered by her husband, a central turn of the novel.

spans.title: Honest, Just a Joke
spans.blurb: Two gunmen pick the wrong taxi to hold up. One passenger has a very large revolver, and the cabbie has a colorful past of his own.

spans.title: The Scissors Duel
spans.blurb: In a prison yard a mocked soldier answers an insult to a young girl's name with a quiet promise. That night, two scissor blades settle it.
